heading: Your Trusted Construction Partner in Port Elizabeth
description: Winzelle Projects is a dedicated team of construction professionals specializing in maintenance, repairs, and waterproofing services. Based in Port Elizabeth, South Africa, we've built our reputation on quality workmanship and reliable service, becoming a trusted name for homeowners and businesses throughout the region.

Our hands-on team provides personalized attention to every project, from routine maintenance jobs to comprehensive waterproofing installations. We combine proven techniques with quality materials to deliver lasting solutions that protect your property. Every project receives our full dedication — you're not just a job number, you're a valued client.
commitmentText: We believe in transparent pricing, quality workmanship, and exceptional customer service. Every project receives our full attention and dedication, ensuring the job is done right the first time. Your satisfaction is our priority, and we work closely with you throughout every stage of your project.
commitmentItems: NHBRC registered for home building & construction
storyText:
It was with great sadness that we had to say goodbye to Winzelle Dried Fruits at the end of December 2024. Due to financial difficulties and other personal issues, we could not continue on that road.

With the start of 2025, new opportunities emerged as we were blessed with maintenance and construction jobs. We still have much to learn, but thanks to good friends that we make on our way, this is creating opportunities we would never have thought of.

Like Joshua crossing the Jordan, we are also faced with uncertainties but the Lord promised us that He will be with us all the way — we need to be "strong and courageous" (Josh 1:9) and He will never forsake us. Thank you for every friend, colleague, family member and stranger that helped us on our way...
